# False Contact Force Appears After Increasing nconmax in Newton; How to Diagnose?

> **Current answer:** Compare nconmax and use_mujoco_contacts in the same environment to confirm if the issue is with the CollisionPipeline, not with the Whole-Body Control (WBC). The fix for this Issue has been integrated into the main branch of Newton PR #2112; temporary switching of MuJoCo contacts is recommended, but should not solely raise the illegal_contact threshold.

## Key terms

- Contact Force (接触力)
- Collision Detection (碰撞检测)
- Whole-Body Control (WBC) (全身控制)

## Problem and symptoms

- The robot terminates immediately after increasing nconmax due to false base contact force.
- Only overflow warning when nconmax ≤ 16; abnormal contact force reaches an extremely high level when nconmax = 32.

## Environment

- Isaac Lab, Newton CollisionPipeline, MJWarpSolverCfg, Anymal-C flat speed environment.

## Priority diagnostics

- Compare use_mujoco_contacts switch, nconmax, and illegal_contact threshold to isolate the contact pipeline.

## Possible causes

- The CollisionPipeline has incorporated an unnecessary contact in high contact capacity scenarios.

## Attempts

- Temporarily raise the illegal_contact threshold and switch to use_mujoco_contacts=True.

## Effective fixes

- The fix has been integrated into the main branch of Newton PR #2112. The maintainer confirmed the fix is in the main branch.

## Result

- The comment confirms that the main branch contains the fix.

## Limitations

- The actual Newton/Isaac Lab version should be recorded; older versions may still require temporary switching of the contact backend.

## Safety notes

- Do not use raising the illegal_contact threshold as a sole solution to mask abnormal contact force and directly migrate to real machine without validation.
